# 📈 EasyTrade — Trading Desk Performance Review
*7-day business review of trading activity, risk concentration, and capital flow.*

This notebook walks through the health of the trading desk: how much volume is moving, whether that volume is dangerously concentrated in a few instruments, how trades are performing, and whether the platform is retaining or losing capital.

input.value:
fetch bizevents, from:-7d
| filter in(event.type, {"com.easytrade.long-buy","com.easytrade.long-sell","com.easytrade.quick-buy","com.easytrade.quick-sell"})
| fieldsAdd notional = amount * price
| summarize total_trades = count(), total_volume = round(sum(notional))

sections.markdown:
## Trading Volume Trend
Trade counts by type (long buy/sell, quick buy/sell) over the review window.

## Instrument Concentration — Risk Lens
Across the 15 traded instruments, the **top 3 account for ~38% of total volume** — a moderately diversified book with no single-instrument concentration risk. The chart below shows the full distribution.

input.value:
fetch bizevents, from:-7d
| filter in(event.type, {"com.easytrade.long-buy","com.easytrade.long-sell","com.easytrade.quick-buy","com.easytrade.quick-sell"})
| fieldsAdd notional = amount * price
| summarize volume = round(sum(notional)), trades = count(), by:{instrumentId}
| sort volume desc

sections.markdown:
## Win / Loss Performance
Long trades close as either a win (target hit) or a loss. Both directions currently sit close to a coin-flip — buy and sell signals are performing symmetrically, with no directional bias worth flagging.

input.value:
fetch bizevents, from:-7d
| filter event.type == "com.easytrade.trade-closed"
| summarize total = count(), wins = countIf(happened == true), by:{direction}
| fieldsAdd win_rate_pct = round(wins * 100.0 / total, decimals:1)

sections.markdown:
## Capital Flow — Deposits vs. Withdrawals
The running (cumulative) net of deposits minus withdrawals shows whether the platform is a net destination or source of customer capital over time. A rising line means the platform is retaining capital; a falling line means customers are net-withdrawing.

input.value:
fetch bizevents, from:-7d
| filter in(event.type, {"com.easytrade.deposit","com.easytrade.withdraw"})
| fieldsAdd signed = if(event.type == "com.easytrade.deposit", amount, else: -amount)
| makeTimeseries net = sum(signed), interval:2h
| fieldsAdd cumulative_net_flow = arrayCumulativeSum(net)

sections.markdown:
## Top Traders by Volume
Our most active accounts by trade volume — useful for VIP/relationship management and understanding who drives desk revenue.

input.value:
fetch bizevents, from:-7d
| filter in(event.type, {"com.easytrade.long-buy","com.easytrade.long-sell","com.easytrade.quick-buy","com.easytrade.quick-sell"})
| fieldsAdd notional = amount * price
| summarize trades = count(), volume = round(sum(notional)), by:{accountId}
| sort volume desc
| limit 10
